semantics.p: High-level transparent latch: follows a when clock=1, holds when clock=0. Evidence: 90-110 ns tracking, 115-140 ns holding.
semantics.q: Captures p at falling clock edge and holds otherwise. Evidence: 55,115,175 ns updates; unchanged during high phases.
semantics.initialization: No initialization; p and q unknown at 0-20 ns. p becomes 0 at 25 ns; q first becomes 0 at 55 ns.
semantics.simultaneous_changes: At 115 ns clock falls while a becomes 0: p retains prior 1 and q captures 1. At 175 ns clock falls while a becomes 1: p retains prior 0 and q captures 0.

verification.oracle: Literal original waveform rows at original 5ns timestamp spacing, sampled after delta settling.
verification.coverage: Initial unknowns, high-phase tracking, low-phase hold, simultaneous falling-edge/input transitions, additional hold and tracking cycles.
verification.checks: Case-inequality comparisons, fatal mismatch, bounded timeout; mandatory dev_check.py initial run.

specification_ambiguities: Finite waveform cannot uniquely establish behavior for all unseen stimuli. Infer q falling-edge capture of p; a low-level latch of p is observationally equivalent on the supplied binary clock waveform. Unknown clock/input behavior beyond initial outputs is unspecified.
